summary: Excise duty valuation on petroleum products; transaction value vs. normal value; validity of MOU-based Import Parity Price (IPP) for inter-OMC sales; extended limitation period invoked; reliance on Hindustan Petroleum Corp. Ltd. Tribunal decision; multiple appeals consolidated; standard: actual price paid or payable under Section 4(3)(d) of Central Excise Act, 1944; differential pricing permissible; show-cause notices challenged; duty demand confirmed or set aside based on IPP acceptance.
final_judgment: Consolidated appeals decided; specific dispositions not fully stated in excerpt but Tribunal decisions relying on Hindustan Petroleum Corp. Ltd. upheld in some cases; extended limitation period issues addressed; duty demands confirmed or set aside based on transaction value interpretation.
